summary: Configured inventory-worker on node1 as an enabled systemd service running under the dedicated inventorysvc account. It remained healthy after a verified node reboot. RHEL 9.8 and kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64 were preserved.
actions_performed: Created the inventorysvc system account with a non-login shell.
Verified the live worker process runs as inventorysvc.
Rebooted node1 safely and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Verified the enabled service and worker process recovered after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Run os-comparison-worker as managed service inventory-worker under inventorysvc
evidence.summary: Shows account creation, valid unit installation, enablement, active service state, configured executable, and live process ownership by inventorysvc.

evidence.requirement: Preserve installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both before and after configuration/reboot show RHEL 9.8 with kernel 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64.

evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart persistence and recovery
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline used boot ID 67c52137-ce51-4fec-b441-23966cea63a8; reboot was acknowledged; the new boot ID is 9ff18f44-1e76-4fab-a6f7-4104c4d69e42; post-reboot evidence shows the service enabled and active with a live inventorysvc-owned worker and no failed units.
